name: com.taboola.android.plus.notifications.scheduled.ScheduledNotificationStateReceiver
description: When a user navigates or taps a Taboola scheduled recommendation notification, this receiver handles its previous/next, dismissal, story, and attribution actions. It opens a tapped story after device unlock when needed.
disableEffect: Taboola scheduled notifications will lose their navigation, dismissal, and story-opening actions.
